title: Orthogonality of sign monomials
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set and let $S,T\\subseteq I$. For a uniformly random sign assignment $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^I$, let $m_S(x)=\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i$. Then $\\mathbb E[m_S(x)m_T(x)]$ equals $1$ if $S=T$ and $0$ otherwise.
